fields.description: Domain identity - replaces the fork's `DASHBOARD_TYPES` dict key (e.g. `financial`, `sales`).
fields.label: Key

fields.description: Icon name, rendered by the frontend's icon set.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: Hex accent colour for the dashboard's chrome.
fields.label: Color

fields.description: The one query this domain reads. Permission-aware and cached like any other `Nakhoda Verified Query` - replaces the fork's per-domain collector.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Chart specs and layout - the dashboard's `items[]` shape (Phase 5/10). Replaces the fork's `_prepare_charts` branch.
fields.label: Panels

fields.description: The playbook fragment routed into the agent's prompt when this domain is in scope - how to read these metrics, what to ask next.
fields.label: Skill

fields.description: The shipping template's qualified id (`{app}/{folder}`), if this record was imported from one. Empty for a record created by hand.
fields.label: From Template

fields.description: The shipped `manifest.json` `version` this copy was last taken from.
fields.label: Imported Version

fields.description: `sha256` of this record as exported at import/update time. Compared against a fresh export on every `migrate` to tell a site-edited copy from a pristine one - see `api/templates.py:_is_customized`.
fields.label: Imported Checksum
